description: Lists the keys a site's serverless functions stored, in key order, with each value's size and when it was written — never the values; store_get reads one. `prefix` narrows it to the keys starting with it (`post:42:` for one post's comments). A page has a `cursor` when there are more keys; pass it back for the next.

site.description: Subdomain or site id, from list_sites.

name: store_list

cursor.description: Pass back for the next page; null after the last.

updatedAt.description: When its value was last written.

title: List a site's store keys
